metadata.warning: PROTOTYPE DEMONSTRATION DATA ONLY. These roles and learner assessments are synthetic fixtures generated for the SIH26101 prototype. They do not represent real civil servants, official personnel records, or authenticated iGOT Karmayogi learner data.

roles.cadre_role: Senior Statistical Officers / Section Officer / Senior Administrative Officer / Administrative Officer
roles.description: Supervises field survey operations, data scrutiny, statistical tabulations, and section administration.

required_competencies.rationale: Supervises survey data validation, tabulation algorithms, outlier scrutiny, and official statistical estimation.
Manages section workflows, file movement, staff duties, and official correspondence.
Drafts analytical survey inspection reports, briefing notes, and coordinates field communications.
Handles field operational stress, unexpected survey sampling roadblocks, and strict survey timelines.

roles.description: Programme director leading national survey rounds, macro-statistical compilations, and inter-cadre supervision.

required_competencies.rationale: Leads multi-year statistical census and survey programmes, milestone delivery, and resource planning.
Steers institutional statistical reforms, methodological modernization, and inter-agency coordination.
Coordinates with Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), line ministries, and international bodies.
Ensures official statistical releases and microdata dissemination satisfy public and policy needs transparently.

roles.cadre_role: Deputy Director General / Joint Secretary Equivalent and Above
roles.description: Apex executive leadership overseeing broad ministerial divisions, national statistical policy, and statutory compliance.

required_competencies.rationale: National statistical strategy, high-level policy advice, and inter-ministerial vision under Mission Karmayogi.
Builds high-level partnerships across state statistical machineries and international agencies.
Conducts disciplinary oversight, upholds administrative integrity, and enforces statutory rules.
Oversees departmental scheme budget formulations, capital allocations, and public finance compliance.

roles.description: Mid-level executive handling procurement of works, establishment rules, and administrative scrutinies.

required_competencies.rationale: Manages procurement tenders, EPC contracts, and ensures adherence to GFR 2017 rules.
Supervises service books, pay fixation under FRSR, deputations, and cadre welfare.
Aligns operational workflows across administrative sections and technical divisions.
Diagnoses bureaucratic bottlenecks and synthesizes administrative solutions.

roles.role_name: Junior Statistical Officer / Assistant Section Officer
roles.cadre_role: Junior Statistical Officers / Assistant Section Officers / Data Processing Assistant (All Grades)
roles.description: Primary fieldwork inspection, primary data compilation, and procedural case file processing.

required_competencies.rationale: Executes data cleaning, script verification, consistency checks, and basic descriptive statistics.
Commitment to ongoing statistical learning, self-reflection, and official statistical integrity.
Field survey respondent interaction, interview questioning, and daily reporting.
Adheres to office procedures, file indexing, and routine noting protocols.
